user_saw: Operators with access to both features saw separate Home and Ask OpenClaw buttons in the collapsed sidebar toolbar, even though Home already offered an Ask OpenClaw tab.
summary: The fix removes the standalone Ask OpenClaw button and its reserved toolbar space, keeping Home as the collapsed toolbar entry point to the shared dock.
reasoning: I checked #133676, which introduced the shared dock, explicitly rendered both launchers, and added a test expecting both for an eligible operator. The removal changes that intended toolbar layout to reduce redundancy while preserving access to Ask OpenClaw.
